subject: Added missing "String" configuration entry (#228)
reason: The change adds a new String configuration entry class to the vmsdk module-config framework, but at this commit no valkey-search code registers a String config: the only instantiation is the new unit test (vmsdk/testing/configuration_test.cc), and all runtime configs remain Number/Boolean/Enum. The code is unreachable in a loaded module build, so both builds expose identical configs, commands and replies — there is no behavior difference a scenario could reach, and no existing path was modified that a fault or workload could stress.
